question: The famous Rath Yatra, Car Festival is associated with which Lord?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lord Jagannath.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Rath Yatra or Car Festival** is a famous festival celebrated in** Puri, Odisha**, and is associated with **Lord Jagannath.** 
 
• The festival involves the procession of Lord Jagannath, along with his siblings,** Lord Balabhadra** and **Goddess Subhadra,** in chariots or raths.
 
• The chariots are pulled by** devotees, **and the procession moves from the Jagannath temple to the **Gundicha temple,** where the deities stay for nine days before returning to the Jagannath temple.
 
• The Rath Yatra is an important festival for devotees of Lord Jagannath, and it is believed that **pulling the chariots** during the festival is a way to attain **moksha or liberation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Shiva **is worshipped in** Puri**.

 
 
• There is a famous temple dedicated to him called the** Lokanath temple.**
 
 
 
• **Lord Indra** is considered the **god of rain and thunder.**
 
 
• He is one of the **major deities** in Hinduism.
 
 
 
• **Lord Brahma** is considered the** creator of the universe** in Hinduism.
 
 
• He is one of the **Trimurti, **along with Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
